description: Find my kids is a family GPS tracker for child safety, parental control and digital wellbeing. You can connect GPS watch or install a special program on your child's device to know child`s live location. Find my kids is a family safety app for parents that will help you not to worry if your children are not with you and they don't hear your calls. ✔ GPS locator – track device of your child, check your child’s live location on the map and the history of movements for the day, make sure that your child doesn't visit dangerous places. Find my kids is a location sharing app. ✔ Sound around – listen to what is happening around your child, to feel certain that he is fine and in a good company. ✔ Loud signal – send a loud signal to the child’s phone if they left the it in a backpack or turned on silent mode and don't hear the call. Find device anytime using Find my device feature. ✔ Application Control – find out what apps they used in school, whether they played in the classroom instead of learning. Our parental control app will help you. ✔ Security control – check that your child has come to school on time – get notifications when he comes to school, return home and other places, that you added manually. Locate a cell phone of your loved one. ✔ Battery control – track your child`s cell phone charge status, remind your child to charge the device in time, the app will send a notification if the battery is low. ✔ Family chat – chat with your child and family in our app with funny stickers. It's the best way to connect with family. Mobile tracking app Find my kids tracker app is intended for family safety and parental control only. The app can not be installed on the cell phone secretly, the use is available only with the explicit consent of the child. Personal data is stored in strict accordance with legislation and GDPR policies. We care about the privacy and security of your family data. Therefore, we align our app with the requirements of the COPPA, the law on the children's protection on the Internet, which confirms the official certificate of the COPPA kidSAFE Seal Program. If your child has a smartphone: Install the Pingo app on your child’s cell phone – GPS tracker for the kid. In the Pingo app, your child will be able to chat with you, and in case of danger, they could press the emergency button. When a child presses the SOS-button, you would immediately receive a loud alarm signal on your cell phone. If your child has a GPS-watch: Connect it with a reliable Find My Kids parent app with a localized interface and technical support. The app is suitable for any device Smart Baby Watch, Smart Age Watch, Smart Pet Tracker, Smart Tracker, Wonlex, Titan Watch and similar How does the Find my kids app work: 1) install the Find my kids locate app on your phone; 2) choose what device you want to connect: child’s phone or GPS-watch; 3) install the Pingo app on the child’s phone or enter the GPS watch SIM card number You can use all the features of the service for free, during the trial period after connecting the child’s device. At the end of this period in the free version, you will be able to see the child’s location online. You need to have a subscription after to use all the functions. The Find my kids app asks for the following permissions: – access to the camera and photo – to install the child's avatar; – access to contacts - to fill in the phone book in GPS-watch; - accessibility services - to limit time at the smartphone screen – access to a microphone - to send voice messages in the chat. In case of technical problems, you can always contact our 24/7 support via chat in the app or send an email to support@findmykids.org.
summary: Family tracker: locate a cell phone, track device and connect with family
